sub: Fictional summary · limits from RBI FAQs and circular

blocks.v: app or bank · reversal by T+1

blocks.text: No public website tracks a UTR

callouts: Open the payment in your app: its status is the tracking.
Not credited? The receiving bank reverses it next day.
Give your bank the UTR, date, amount and IFSC.
Customers cannot track RTGS; the bank tells you.
Never share a PIN or OTP with a tracking helper.
